Featured Manager · GW6

The Best Team in the League Is 2-3

bjennings28 has outscored nearly everyone, nearly every week, and has a losing record to show for it

Put every team up against the whole league each week, rather than the one opponent the schedule hands out, and bjennings28 comes out 40-15. Nobody else is close. In the actual table he is seventh.

The explanation is not complicated. Twice in five weeks he has run into the highest score anybody posted that round, and both times he was the one standing across from it. That is the whole difference between his record and the leaders'. He has scored like a contender in four weeks of five and been handed a loss for three of them.

The one honest blemish was last week, his first real off day, and it came against a side having the game of its season. The schedule owes him, and over thirty-three more weeks it tends to pay.
